integrity: The complete-bipartite theorem in arXiv:2509.11358v1 was inspected directly. Its stated nontrivial cases are upper bounds rather than a full exact formula. The new claim was checked against semantic literature searches, exact-phrase searches, the ordinary k-coalition analogue, and prior owned results on fair coalitions and fair domination.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to the 2-fair coalition number on complete bipartite graphs; it does not classify all extremal partitions or arbitrary k. Exhaustive computation is used only as corroboration on small orders; the proof is analytic for all part sizes.
title: Exact \(2\)-fair coalition numbers of complete bipartite graphs
